messages:
maya: Quick huddle — kicked off the Sherpa pilot scope doc. Nimbus Labs wants batching + quantization recommendations and eval-triggered alerts for their pilot. Can we align launch criteria now?
darin: I can join. Engineering ask: p95 latency target <= 250ms for typical gen flows (8k context). Also want cost delta vs their baseline < 15%.
olivia: From product: acceptance criteria proposal — (1) canary at 5% traffic, (2) automated eval regression < 2% on our golden set, (3) documented runbook + rollback play.
samir: Engineering notes — quant options to test: int8 per-channel, q4f, and mixed-precision. Need perf matrix across seq lengths. Batching policy: adaptive up to 64 with latency-aware cutoff (priority to SLO).
elaine: Ops/compliance: we need tenant-scoped audit logs, metric tags for Nimbus, KMS key rotation plan. Nimbus is asking for a pilot SLA of 99.9% availability windowed. Can we meet that for canary?
maya: Action items: samir -> perf matrix + quant tradeoffs by Fri, olivia -> draft acceptance checklist & canary playbook, elaine -> confirm infra quotas & compliance checklist. @eng-bot can you schedule the canary?
eng-bot: deploy-bot: Canary scheduled for 2024-06-10 02:00 UTC (feature flag: sherpa.pilot).
samir: Uploaded initial perf draft (link: https://redwood.internal/docs/sherpa/perf-matrix.md). Quick snippet: `batch_size=32, tokens/sec=1200, p95=230ms` which meets the latency SLO for that config. Need full matrix for other seqs.
olivia: On eval-triggered alerts — propose thresholds: automated metric drop >1.5% on heldset OR generation-quality regression >2% triggers immediate rollback to baseline variant; send pager to #eng-oncall and notify customer success.
maya: I agree. Customer sign-off clause: Nimbus runs their canonical prompts + we compare to baseline; their product manager must approve before broader ramp. Timeline: get pilot gating docs to Sales by EOW.
elaine: :thumbsup: I'll confirm infra quota and file-level compliance answers today.
maya: Thanks all — quick sync tomorrow 11:00am PT to confirm blockers and close the checklist.
